about: Guidance for registering a patent in the UAE through the Ministry of Economy.
note: Requirements read from the official AD.iP (Abu Dhabi IP) guidance page on the checked date. AD.iP gives guidance and the filing is made with the Ministry of Economy, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: The invention must be technical, new, involve an inventive step, and be useful and industrially applicable
documents: Abstract, claims, description and drawings in Arabic and English
Assignment and certified copy of the priority application
Trade licence and memorandum of association (companies only)
Power of attorney for residents or companies registered outside the UAE
PCT documents and sequence listing where they apply
channels: A patent attorney or registered agent is recommended; AD.iP lists providers
AD.iP: 800555, Baniyas Towers, Abu Dhabi, Mon-Thu 8 am to 3 pm, Fri 8 am to 11:30 am
